about: Frozen question sets of the assistant's iterations (T-4729, owner 2026-10-19 08:05Z and 08:08Z). `iteration` is asked before and after each change, one change at a time; `opendata25` and `rag25` are the final before/after rerun. Ids name questions of opendata_questions.json (data-eval-gemini) and bbsk_web_questions.json (bbsk-web-eval-gemini). Never edit a set after its baseline: add a new set.
